Name: New NPC Lorence 1.6
Author: muxuelaiyin
Description:
你好，这里是洛伦斯的非官方1.6更新，已获得原作者授权。

洛伦斯是一位来自星际的虫族战士，他在逃亡途中和族人们失散，飞船坠毁在了星露谷。他一直在矿洞周围收集矿石想修好自己的飞船，他经常去铁匠铺，博物馆还有冒险者工会。他在下雨天会变回虫的形态，最爱各种矿物。

如何解锁洛伦斯：
0-1：游戏时间六天后，6：00-17：30前往山岭。
0-2：看过0-1,9：00-17：30前往罗宾家。
0-3：游戏事件十天后，看过0-2，6：00-20：20前往山岭。
0-4：看过0-3，9：00-15：00前往镇上。
好感事件：
0-5：看过0-4,6：00-20：30前往山岭。
2：看过0-5,9：00-17：30前往博物馆。
4：看过2,9：00-17：30前往镇上。
6：看过4,9：00-17：30前往博物馆。
7：看过6,20：00-23：00前往镇上。
8-1：看过7，收到信，13：00-23：00前往矿井。
8-2：看过8-1,9：00-17：30前往镇上。
10：看过8-2，和洛伦斯约会，9：00-17：30前往镇上。
12：看过10，和洛伦斯结婚，房子升到3级，10：00-16：00进入农舍。
14：看过12,8：00-17：00进入农舍。

行程：
周一到周五：八点去探险家工会-十点去矿井-15点去铁匠铺-22点回矿井睡觉
周六：8点去探险家工会-10点去矿井-15点去铁匠铺-20点去酒吧-22点回矿井睡觉
周日：9点去矿井-14点去博物馆-22点回矿井睡觉
夏天：9点去探险家工会-10点去矿井一直呆到晚上睡觉
秋天：八点去探险家工会-10点去矿井-15点去法师塔-20点回矿井睡觉
婚后周六日：10点去矿井-15点去铁匠铺

PS：
这个MOD应该和几乎所有MOD兼容。
肖像含有虫形态，怕虫者慎入或自行下载美化！展示图中的美化来自20121，需要999作为前置。
有任何问题请在这里或者XHS向我报告，我有空就会修，但请描述得详细一点，因为我比较菜。

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28473]English Translation[/url] by Sakialyn

Hello, this is an unofficial 1.6 update from Lorence, authorized by the original author.

Lorence is a Zerg warrior from space. He got separated from his tribe during his escape and his spaceship crashed in Stardew Valley. He has been collecting minerals around the mine to repair his spaceship. He often goes to blacksmith shops, museums, and adventurer unions. He will revert back to the form of a insect on rainy days and loves various minerals the most.

How to unlock Lorence:
0-1: Six days after the game, head to the mountains from 6:00 to 17:30.
0-2: Seen 0-1, go to Robin's house from 9:00-17:30.
0-3: Ten days after the game,Seen 0-2, 6:00-20:20 heading to the mountains.
0-4: Seen 0-3, go to town from 9:00-15:00.

Hearts event:
0-5: Seen 0-4, 6:00-20:30 heading to the mountains.
2: Seen 0-5, go to the museum from 9:00-17:30.
4: Seen 2, go to town from 9:00-17:30.
6: Seen 4, go to the museum from 9:00-17:30.
7: Seen 6, go to town from 20:00-23:00.
8-1: Seen 7, received the letter, go to the mine from 13:00-23:00.
8-2: Seen 8-1, go to town from 9:00-17:30.
10: Seen 8-2, date with Lorence, go to town from 9:00-17:30.
12: Seen 10, marry Lorenz, upgrade the house to level 3, enter the farmhouse from 10:00-16:00.
14: Seen 12, entered the farmhouse from 8:00 to 17:00.

PS：
This MOD should be compatible with almost all MODs.
The portrait contains insect forms. Those who are afraid of insects should be cautious or download other portrait beautification options!The beautification in the display image is from 20121 and requires 999 as a prefix.
